The workbook generation failed because multiple expected data ranges in the 'Task' sheet were empty (None) instead of containing calculated values.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells in the 'top block' (H12:L17) and 'net metric' (H35:L40) returned None instead of the expected float values (e.g., H12 expected 612.5, H35 expected 4.499). While the workbook and sheet creation worked (4 tests passed), the logic for populating these specific matrices or their underlying formulas is missing or failing to execute.
